ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a transition-state structure, with a tetrahedral carbon at the center; the left side of this central carbon is connected through oxygen to an ortho-substituted benzene ring, and the ortho position of the benzene ring bears an acetyl group C(=O)CH3; the upper right of the central carbon is connected to an oxygen bearing hydrogen, namely OH; the upper left of the central carbon is connected to a carbon-chain terminus labeled R; the lower right of the central carbon is connected through oxygen to an acyl group C(=O), and the other side of this acyl group is connected to a carbon-chain terminus labeled R. There are also reaction arrows in the figure, but the question requires the arrows to be ignored. Reasoning: According to the specified method, start from the R on the ester acyl side. Use * to represent R, obtaining *C connected to the carbonyl, namely *CC(=O). Continue through the ester oxygen to the central tetrahedral carbon, obtaining *CC(=O)OC. The central carbon has an OH branch, written as (O); it has a carbon substituent connected to R, written as (C*); and also has a phenoxy group connected through oxygen to the aromatic ring. The ortho-substituted benzene ring is written as Oc1ccccc1, and an acetyl group C(C)=O is added at the adjacent position. Merging gives SMILES: *CC(=O)OC(O)(C*)Oc1ccccc1C(C)=O.

method.method_draft: Begin at the R group on the ester acyl side and encode it as '*C' attached to a carbonyl, giving '*CC(=O)'. Continue through the ester oxygen to the central tetrahedral carbon, giving '*CC(=O)OC'. Add the central carbon branches: an OH branch '(O)', a carbon substituent ending in R as '(C*)', and the phenoxy oxygen leading to the aryl ring as 'O...' . Encode the ortho-disubstituted phenyl ring as 'Oc1ccccc1' and add the adjacent acetyl substituent as 'C(C)=O'. Combining these pieces yields '*CC(=O)OC(O)(C*)Oc1ccccc1C(C)=O'.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中显示一个过渡态结构，中心为四面体碳；该中心碳左侧通过氧连接到一个邻位取代的苯环，苯环邻位带有乙酰基 C(=O)CH3；中心碳右上连接一个带氢的氧，即 OH；中心碳左上连接一个碳链末端标为 R；中心碳右下通过氧连接到酰基 C(=O)，该酰基另一侧接碳链末端标为 R。图中还有反应箭头，但题目要求忽略箭头。推理：按指定方法，从酯酰基侧的 R 开始，用 * 表示 R，得到 *C 接到羰基，即 *CC(=O)。继续经过酯氧连接到中心四面体碳，得到 *CC(=O)OC。中心碳有 OH 分支，写作 (O)；有连接到 R 的碳取代基，写作 (C*)；还有经氧连接到芳环的苯氧基。邻位取代苯环写为 Oc1ccccc1，并在相邻位置加乙酰基 C(C)=O。合并得到 SMILES：*CC(=O)OC(O)(C*)Oc1ccccc1C(C)=O。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: This is the direct structure-to-SMILES route: identify each drawn atom/bond in the transition-state drawing while explicitly ignoring curved arrows, then serialize the whole molecule from one R terminus through the ester and central tetrahedral carbon to the aromatic ring and acetyl substituent.
planner_metadata.image_role: Read the line-angle structure: an ortho-disubstituted benzene ring has one substituent as phenoxy O bonded to a central tetrahedral carbon, and the adjacent ring carbon bears an acetyl group C(=O)CH3. The central carbon is also bonded to an OH group, to a carbon substituent ending in R, and to an ester oxygen connected to C(=O)-CH2-R. Ignore all curved arrows around the O/H atoms.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the prompt instruction that the requested output is the SMILES expression of the transition-state structure and that the arrows should be ignored; no option text is needed.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use standard SMILES conventions: represent unspecified R attachment points as wildcard atoms '*'; aromatic benzene as 'c1ccccc1' with branches/substituents; carbonyl as 'C(=O)'; ester linkage as 'C(=O)O' or 'OC(=O)' depending on traversal; branches on the central saturated carbon are written in parentheses. The OH attached to the central carbon is represented as 'O' in a branch.
